description:
Freedom Technology Solutions Group is seeking a motivated Software Engineer to join our team developing geospatial analysis, data processing, visualization, and AI-enabled solutions using modern cloud technologies and the ArcGIS Enterprise technology stack.

 This is a prime contract opportunity where you'll work alongside experienced engineers on mission-critical systems while building your skills in software development, AWS, artificial intelligence, geospatial technologies, and DevOps.

 You don't need to be a GIS or AI expert to be successful in this role. We're looking for someone with a solid software development foundation, curiosity, and a willingness to learn and experiment with emerging technologies.

 What You'll Do

 As a Software Engineer, you'll contribute to applications and services that process, analyze, and visualize geospatial data. You'll also have opportunities to explore how AI and machine learning can be incorporated into applications, development workflows, data analysis, and automation.

 You'll have the opportunity to:

 
 Develop, test, and maintain software applications, APIs, and geospatial services.

 Write clean, maintainable code using languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript, C#, C++, or .NET.

 Work with experienced engineers to design and implement new capabilities.

 Explore the use of AI and generative AI to enhance applications, automate workflows, analyze data, and improve software development processes.

 Gain experience integrating AI models and services through APIs into software applications and workflows.

 Learn how applications integrate with ArcGIS Enterprise, databases, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and AI-enabled services.

 Work with AWS and cloud-based development and deployment environments.

 Use Git and modern software development workflows to manage and collaborate on code.

 Participate in code reviews and learn software engineering best practices from experienced team members.

 Troubleshoot software issues and help improve application performance and reliability.

 Gain exposure to CI/CD, DevOps, containers, APIs, AI-assisted development, and enterprise software deployment.

 Work with geospatial data and near-real-time data feeds supporting mission applications.

 
 Required Qualifications

 
 Active TS/SCI with Polygraph

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. Four (4) years of additional relevant experience may be substituted for a bachelor's degree.

 Coursework, internship, project, or professional experience with at least one programming or scripting language such as Java, Python, JavaScript, C#, C++, .NET, or SQL.

 Basic understanding of software development concepts and object-oriented programming.

 Familiarity with source control tools such as Git.

 Interest in learning cloud technologies, AI/ML, enterprise software development, and geospatial systems.

 Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn.

 Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively within a technical team.

 
 Desired Qualifications

 
 Artificial intelligence, machine learning, or generative AI

 Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI APIs

 AI-assisted software development tools

 AWS or other cloud platforms

 JavaScript and Node.js

 Python

 REST APIs and web services

 Linux

 CI/CD and DevOps concepts

 Databases and SQL

 Docker or container technologies

 GIS, mapping, or geospatial data

 Esri ArcGIS products

 Near-real-time data processing

 
 Academic projects, internships, personal projects, hackathons, or other hands-on experience with AI/ML, LLMs, Python, cloud technologies, or geospatial applications are a plus.

 Technologies You'll Work With

 Our environment includes a broad mix of modern software, cloud, AI, and geospatial technologies:

 Python • JavaScript • Node.js • .NET • AWS • AI/ML • Generative AI • LLMs • Git • Linux • REST APIs • Kong • Tomcat • Nginx • ArcGIS Enterprise • GeoEvent Server • MapProxy 

 Why This Is a Great Early-Career Opportunity

 This role provides an opportunity to build experience across some of today's most valuable technical areas: software engineering, AWS, AI/ML, enterprise systems, DevOps, and geospatial technology—while working on a prime contract supporting mission-critical customer requirements.

 You'll work alongside experienced engineers who can help you grow your technical skills while giving you opportunities to experiment with emerging technologies and take on increasing responsibility as you develop.

 If you're early in your software engineering career and looking for a place where you can write real code, explore AI, learn modern cloud technologies, and contribute to meaningful systems, we'd like to hear from you.

 The estimated salary range for this position is between $110,000-$155,000 (annualized USD). This range reflects the typical pay for the role and is one part of the company's comprehensive compensation package. Actual salaries are influenced by several factors, such as location, the individual’s education, skills, experience, and competencies, as well as contract affordability and organizational needs. 
  

 What’s in It for You? 

 Flexible work environment

 A team mentality – work with friendly, like-minded professionals

 Work with innovative, cutting edge technologies

 Enjoy extremely competitive compensation and benefits

 A work-life balance you can count on

 Opportunities to grow and advance your career on our dime

  

 The Benefits You Get with Freedom 

 Amazing benefits including matching 401k, fully paid medical, and more

 Generous paid time off – including paid site closure days

 Competitive salary offerings

 Paid training and tuition reimbursement

 Referral bonuses

 Fully paid life and disability

 Annual logo wear allowance

 Company sponsored events (game nights, holiday party, summer party, happy hours)

 Interested in learning more about Freedom and our culture?  Contact us today!  We’re constantly hosting hiring events in our office and elsewhere, to help you get a sense of what life is like at Freedom before joining the team.

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability or veteran status
